Buffalo Tuna Salad
By: Alison Cunha
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 12:47pm

Ingredients




1 rib of celery (optional)
1 can of tuna
a few globs of veggie spread (or plain greek yogurt) 

a little bit of buffalo sauce (to taste)

Preparation

1 Chop celery into bite-sized slices 2 Mix all ingredients 3 Use to top crackers or in a sandwich or wrap

About


Not Hungry?!
By Ali
Morning! How is your Tuesday going? Mine is going well. In an effort to get some quality sleep (I only got 5 hours on Sunday night), I skipped blogging last night and headed right to bed. But, I didn’t end up falling asleep until about 11pm anyhow! Ugh!
I have to admit I was super surprised as the response I got from readers about my acne (if you haven’t read that post, click here). I had no idea there were so many other people suffering with adult acne, I guess I am not alone. Thanks to all of you for sharing your experiences and thanks to my brother and sister-in-law that commented that never even noticed I had acne, they are very  sweet, but are filthy liars ;)
Anyhow, let me back up to yesterday evening. During class to keep me from wanting to chew my arm off (since dinner was eaten at 9pm) I snacked on some grapes and a Honey Almond Flax Kashi bar.
In class, We were supposed to watch a documentary that Diane Sawyer did about cyber bullying, but we didn’t get to it. I was kind of disappointed because it seems so interesting. I know I am a dork! Has anyone seen it? Is it interesting? I think it may be a few years old.We will be watching it next week, I think.
After class, I went to my par-time job where I worked until almost 9pm. By the time I got home, I was feeling hungry and tired. If you remember, I got up at 5:30 am for Body Pump and had been going non-stop since! This is my life, people!
When it was time to eat I just wanted something quick. I whipped up some Buffalo Tuna Salad.
    * 1 can of tuna
    * a few globs of veggie spread
    * a little bit of buffalo sauce
I used this veggie spread.
You can also use plan greek yogurt too, they both work fine.
I added the the Tuna Salad to a whole wheat wrap, topped it with american cheese, folded it up and pressed it on the Forman Grill for a few minutes.
Dessert was a Dark Chocolate Pumpkin cookie.
YUM YUM!
This morning when I woke up, I wasn’t very hungry and nothing seemed appetizing at all. So, I got ready for work and did some laundry while waiting for the hunger and breakfast craving to arrive. But, it never did. I wonder what was going on… Anyhow, not eating would be a bad idea, so I ate the only thing I felt I could stomach.
2 slices of Ezekiel Cinnamon Raisin Toast with Earth Balance Buttery Spread and some grapes…with coffee.
Here is today’s outfit:
Hot Pink Cardigan (Old Navy), White Cami (H&M- wow I have a lot of white cami’s from H&M, huh?), Brown pencil Skirt (TJ MAXX), Brown Boots (TJ MAXX), Tights (Target). I actually got this skirt taken in 2 inches in the waist and it fits PERFECT now :)
Here is a close up of the necklace, which was my grandmother’s. I love wearing something of  hers when I can, it makes my day, I miss her a lot!
In Other News:
1. In Honor of Thanksgiving being right around the corner, I will be posting something I am thankful for in every post. PLEASE feel free to join in in the comments section! So for this post:
I AM THANKFUL FOR: Bloggers!!!!!
I am thankful to be part of a HUGE blogging community! These ladies are inspirations, knowledgeable resources, and super fun! Not only have I learned a lot from being part of this community, but I have made a few pals along the way too :)
Your Truly, Sarah, Whit and Amy.
Heather, Kelly, Jenna, Meghann, Whit, Chandra, Yours Truely, and Melissa.
Me and Jenna (Jenna’s Blog was actually the first one I ever read!)
Me and Caitlin. That is us showing the size of our wiener dogs. We both have dachshunds!
Reminders:
1. Don’t forget about my blogger interviews!
For Bloggers: Please let me know if you are interested in being interviewed and highlighted in these interviews/ get ready for an e-mail from me asking you to be involved ;) All of you that have contacted me so far have been added to the list.
For Readers and Bloggers: Let me know what questions you think should be asked it can be about their blog (for example: Why did you start blogging) or about them personally (For example: How do you take your coffee). If you want to submit a question(s) shoot me an e-mail (foodfitnessfashion@gmail.com) or comment on this post. I have already gotten some great questions!!! This is super important, if you want specific questions asked get them to me!!! You have until Thursday at 5pm!!!
2. Don’t forget about the Athena Cup. I donated 18 BRAS !!!! I got a few e-mails about this. If you want to donate, you can click on the link and the instructions are there. You do not need to send things to me directly (although if that is how you want to do it, no problem, that’s fine).
